messages:
sophia: FYI we started the OFED+EFA firmware roll in ap-southeast2 at 22:00 UTC and seeing a small fraction of training jobs hang in NCCL allreduce. Not cluster-wide but persistent on ~12 hosts in gpu-pool-3.
liam: I see ~6% of distributed jobs stall with no GPU utilization change. nccl hangs on recv/send, jobs show stuck at 'exchange ranks'.
nina: infra-bot flagged elevated nccl retries: "nccl: retry timeout" metrics spiked. Pulled logs from one bad host. Relevant bits: 
```
# ip link show eth0
3: eth0: mtu 9000 qdisc mq state UP mode DEFAULT group default qlen 1000
# dmesg | tail -n 10
mlx5_core 0000:af:00.0: link 4 changed to DOWN
mlx5_core 0000:af:00.0: mlx5p eth0: TX timeout, reset scheduled
mlx5_core 0000:af:00.0: failed to set mtu 9000: protocol error
```
liam: Captured traffic with tcpdump -s 128 -n: lots of ICMP type=3 code=4 (frag needed) coming back when large RDMA/TCP packets sent. Many of these ICMPs are being dropped by intermediate switch ACLs.
omar: We pushed OFED 6.2.0 + fw 1.5.2 that tightened PMTU behavior on the NIC. If ICMP frag-needed is filtered or net.ipv4.ip_no_pmtu_disc=1, kernel disallows reducing path MTU -> sender keeps sending jumbo frames -> blackhole.
sophia: Confirmed several ToR switches negotiate 1500 while hosts set 9000. The packet flow expects ICMP feedback but some ACLs strip those messages.
liam: Quick mitigations tested:
- set host mtu to 1500: immediate progress resumed on allreduce within 90s
- sysctl net.ipv4.ip_no_pmtu_disc=0 on affected nodes: also restored progress in a test case
- NCCL fallback env NCCL_NET_DISABLE=1 works but performance drops ~3.5x

nina: We need a safe rollout plan. Proposal:
1) Quarantine gpu-pool-3 (stop new scheduling)
2) Canary 4 nodes: set mtu 1500 + restart mlx5_core module + run nccl_allreduce_smoke (10 min)
3) If canaries green, batch-change rest in pool-3 in groups of 10 with 30m soak
4) If cannot roll safely, rollback OFED/fw to previous package and re-run failed jobs

omar: Also add to checklist: preflight PMTU probe against ToR (send paths of varying sizes and confirm ICMP responses), and verify switch ACLs allow type=3 code=4.
sophia: Cost note from sre-ops: 12 affected nodes x avg 4 GPUs x 5 hours = 240 GPU-hours wasted. At $3/GPU-hr ~ $720 immediate. If we re-run full jobs after rollback could be several thousand.
sre-ops: Filing incident INC-2026-204, tagging CS for any Dedicated customers on that cluster. Notify customers and pause further auto-upgrades in ap-southeast2.
liam: I'm running ansible playbook to flip MTU on 4 canaries now, results in ~15m. Will post outcome. Playbook steps include: ip link set dev eth0 mtu 1500; modprobe -r mlx5_core; modprobe mlx5_core; sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_no_pmtu_disc=0; run nccl_allreduce_smoke.sh
nina: Action owners: liam - canary + playbook; omar - collect full firmware/drivers matrix and map to host list; sophia - open rollback package + incident coordination; sre-ops - cost & customer comms.
liam: Canary 1/4 done: smoke passed after MTU flip. Canary 2/4 passed after sysctl tweak (it had ip_no_pmtu_disc=1). Canary 3 had older NIC firmware that failed to negotiate 1500 without driver reload; reload fixed it and smoke passed. Canary 4 queued.
sophia: Good. Please hold bulk rollout until we verify switch ACLs in the rack. Also schedule a maintenance window for Dedicated customer clusters before any changes.
infra-bot: upgrade-bot: OFED+fw rollout completed on 128 nodes in ap-southeast2; 12 nodes reported post-upgrade health alerts. Incident INC-2026-204 created.
sre-ops: Postmortem action items being tracked: add PMTU preflight, add nccl-allreduce smoke to post-upgrade health checks, stop setting ip_no_pmtu_disc=1 by default in images unless explicitly documented, add canary gating for NIC firmware mismatches.
sophia: Thanks team. Keep logs and commands in the incident doc and don't schedule further infra upgrades in region until checklist updated. :thumbsup:
